Compute SOL is only 12% — the GPU is barely doing any useful work. Enabling TF32 (allow_tf32=True in tl.dot) routes the dot-product accumulation through Tensor Cores at ~8x the throughput of FP32 FFMA. K=480 is moderate, so accumulated TF32 rounding error (mantissa 23→10 bits) is within acceptable bounds for typical inference workloads. Additionally, the kernel has 128 registers/thread which severely limits occupancy (only 4 blocks/SM possible). The 12-way shared memory bank conflicts (69.64% speedup potential) are a secondary bottleneck that autotune can also address by exploring different tile configurations.
